best_section.where: small gravel car park on the creek track, about 30 m north-east of the pin

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by mangroves and bush on three sides; no dwellings in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Reached by a formed track off the road; other vehicles already parked there.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end creek-side track, not a through route.
drivers.convention: Cars (and what looks like a boat trailer) already parked here.

flags: Low-lying, tidal creek bank nearby (min elevation about -0.3 m) — check flood/tide risk
Steep creek bank close by (DEM shows up to 33% grade) — stay on the flat car park, not the bank
reasons: Gravel car park already used by other vehicles
Backs onto mangroves and bush, well hidden
Flat, formed track access from the road
summary: Small secluded gravel car park off a creek-side track, already used by other vehicles.
sun_shade: Open gravel patch ringed by trees; mixed shade from surrounding bush, more open to the sky than the creek banks either side.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park entrance has a gate or barrier
Ground firmness for a 2WD van (gravel vs soft sand/mud)
Local tide levels and whether the track floods
